mapper.select: select count(*) from ( select ENTRUST_ID from WFL_IBU_QUOTE_BOND2 where ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId} union all select ENTRUST_ID from WFL_IBU_QUOTE_CREP where ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId} union all select ENTRUST_ID from IBU_QUOTE_BOND where ENTRUST_ID= #{entrustId} and TRADE_STATUS not in (#{QUOTE_STUTAS_IBU_08},#{QUOTE_STUTAS_IBU_14},#{QUOTE_STUTAS_IBU_15}) union all select ENTRUST_ID from IBU_QUOTE_CREP where ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId} and TRADE_STATUS not in (#{QUOTE_STUTAS_IBU_08},#{QUOTE_STUTAS_IBU_14},#{QUOTE_STUTAS_IBU_15}) )

select count(*) from ( select ENTRUST_ID from wfl_reg_fin_product_deal where ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId} and trade_status='01' and is_cancel='N' union all select ENTRUST_ID from reg_fin_product_deal where ENTRUST_ID= #{entrustId} and trade_status='01' and is_cancel='N' )

SELECT ee.ENTRUST_STATUS entrustStatus, CASE WHEN fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '01' THEN NULL WHEN (bobrt.BID_MODLE IS NOT NULL AND bobrt.BID_MODLE = '03') OR bobrt.IS_WIN = 'Y' THEN '04' WHEN bobrt.BID_MODLE IS NULL THEN '01' WHEN bobrt.IS_WIN = 'N' THEN '03' WHEN (bobrt.BID_MODLE IN ('01', '02') AND bobrt.IS_WIN IS NULL) THEN '02' ELSE '05' END AS firstBidStatus, ee.PS ps FROM ETR_ENTRUST ee LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = ee.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE fpi ON fpi.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT bo.BID_MODLE, brt.IS_WIN ,bo.FINPROD_ID,bobp.ENTRUST_ID FROM BID_ORDER bo LEFT JOIN BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE bobp ON bobp.BID_ID = bo.BID_ID LEFT JOIN BID_RESULT_TOTAL brt ON brt.BID_ID = bo.BID_ID AND brt.STATUS = '01' AND brt.FINPROD_ID = bo.FINPROD_ID WHERE bo.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND bo.TRADE_STATUS = '01' GROUP BY bo.BID_MODLE, brt.IS_WIN, bo.FINPROD_ID,bobp.ENTRUST_ID ) bobrt ON bobrt.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID AND bobrt.ENTRUST_ID = ee.ENTRUST_ID where ee.ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId}
